mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, p.PP_Name as ppName, d.PD_Name as pdName from SYS_Position_P p left join SYS_Department_P d on p.PD_ID=d.PD_ID left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id= d.P_Id left join SYS_PositionP_Role pr on pr.PP_ID=p.PP_ID where pr.Role_ID=#{roleId}
select count(*) from SYS_Position_P p left join SYS_Department_P d on p.PD_ID=d.PD_ID
select max(PP_Sort) from SYS_Position_P where PD_ID=#{pdId}
mapper.sql: p.PP_ID as ppId, p.PD_ID as pdId, p.PP_Name as ppName, p.PP_Code as ppCode, p.PP_Remark as ppRemark, p.PP_Sort as ppSort, p.PP_Status as ppStatus, p.PP_MDM_NO as ppMdmNo, p.PP_CreateTime as ppCreatetime, p.PP_CreateU_ID as ppCreateuId, p.PP_CreateU_Name as ppCreateuName
mapper.select: select d.PD_Id as pdId, d.PD_Code as pdCode, p.PP_ID as ppId, p.PP_Name as ppName, p.PP_Code as ppCode, d.owner_unit as ownerUnit, c.C_Name as ownerUnitName, d.PD_Name as pdName from SYS_Position_P p left join SYS_Department_P d on p.PD_ID=d.PD_ID left join sys_company c on c.C_ID=d.owner_unit WHERE d.P_ID=#{pId} and p.PP_Status = '1' and d.PD_Status = '1' and (d.pd_code=#{yzdwoCode} or d.pd_code=#{yzdwtCode}) order by p.Pp_Sort asc
